sentences.en: as you can see with the black background, we are getting back to it because Eden is in a very good state right now, thank God.

sentences.en: So you quite literally wasted your time thinking you were learning, when you could have actually been learning in the first place, and engaging with reality and trial and error.

sentences.en: That's me saying that a digital commonplace isn't like an absolute requirement to success, but it definitely helps in it.

sentences.en: so rather than this being a second brain, I like to think of it as a second subconscious.
